gaps.title: The customer-facing clarity number has no consensus-certified model deployed
gaps.whyItMatters: Production serves secchi-power-v1 (gauge-driven, validated without a gate) and rain-decay-v0 (not validated). A certified research candidate exists but is NOT_DEPLOYED, so no lake reaches the 'strong' evaluated state.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether a bowfisher can plan a trip on the published clarity number or only on the 'which part of the lake looks better' satellite hint.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when a promotion decision for a deployed model is made by Michael, or when the next step needs a decision rather than evidence.
gaps.expectedOutput: A recorded accept / reject / keep-in-calibration decision for the research candidate against live production data and historical Secchi/turbidity records.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: OPTIONAL: any existing or owner-supplied observations may be added as evidence; they are never required.

gaps.title: No customer clarity class taxonomy exists (clarityClass is unpublished)
gaps.whyItMatters: The Engine publishes feet only; band names and cut-points were never decided, so the Brain publishes clarityClass as unknown rather than inventing one.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: How a clarity number maps to a go / no-go reading for bowfishing.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when Michael decides the band names and cut-points.
gaps.expectedOutput: An approved band taxonomy and its evidence rule.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: OPTIONAL: any existing or owner-supplied observations may be added as evidence; they are never required.

gaps.title: Gauge reading times are unknown in the Engine payload
gaps.whyItMatters: The estimate restates the Engine /conditions answer; the observation time of the driving gauge reading is not in that payload, so evidence freshness for gauge-driven lakes stays UNKNOWN (never substituted by the Engine evaluation time).
gaps.bowfisherDecision: How recent the real-world measurement behind a clarity number is.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the owning component exposes a reading time, or when the Brain reads provider data directly under an approved contract.
gaps.expectedOutput: A published gauge observation time per lake, or a recorded decision to keep it UNKNOWN.
